snippet.title: Hello Neighbor: Vintage Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello Neighbor: Vintage is a #fangame reimagining of #helloneighbor using concepts from its original alpha builds. 

Download the fangame for free on GameJolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/vintage/1022742

Find more information about the game here and chat with us: https://discord.gg/SbFwbxp9gx
